component.name: Appseal
component.summary: Sandbox AppImages and manage their permissions

description.p: Appseal is a Flatseal-style permission manager for AppImages. It unpacks AppImages without running them, recommends safe permissions, and launches them inside a Bubblewrap sandbox.

ul.li: Plain-language permission toggles with risk levels and warnings
Desktop launchers that always start apps through the sandbox
Optional Bubblejail and Firejail backends, Landlock defense in depth
